brief_rationale: The doctor consistently met all serious responsibility-chain items (RC1–RC6) without any chain error. RC7 (receipt confirmation) was only partially addressed: the doctor gave detailed plans and summaries but never explicitly asked the patient to repeat back or confirm understanding, constituting a minor omission. This minor error caps the grade at 2, despite the trajectory demonstrating multiple high-order activations and excellent clinical reasoning. No serious error or unmitigated safety risk is present.
